title: U.S. Tariffs Could Price Canadian Firms Out of U.S. and Threaten Thousands of Jobs
summary: The 50 percent tariffs President Trump imposed on Canadian exports to the United States will make it impossible for many Canadian companies to continue to sell to the U.S. market, economists say.

title: How U.S.-Canada Tariff Negotiations Turned Into an All-Out Trade War
summary: Detailed accounts of the final hours of the negotiations show that, while the United States offered Canada what it said was the best deal of any country, what Canada had to give up in exchange was seen as unthinkable.

title: What We Know About Australia’s Bird Flu, Which Has Crossed Over to Mammals
summary: Australia confirmed its first case of H5N1 in June in migratory seabirds. Since then, the virus has spread rapidly, straining government responses.

title: Chinese Artist Sentenced to Three Years in Prison for Mao Sculptures
summary: Gao Zhen, part of a brotherly duo famous for satirical artworks, was convicted of slandering one of China’s heroes after a secret one-day trial.

title: Australia Bans Generative A.I. From Official Music Charts
summary: Under new rules, recordings developed using generative A.I. will only be allowed if they are “substantially human-made,” the peak body says.

title: Trump Administration to Return Diplomats to Middle East Embassies
summary: Evacuated foreign service officers could begin heading back to their posts as early as this week, an internal document shows, suggesting Washington does not anticipate a renewal of full-scale conflict with Iran.

title: Christian Convert Who Fled Iran and Was Deported By Trump Finds New Home
summary: Artemis Ghasemzadeh, who had escaped religious persecution, was deported to Panama under Trump’s immigration crackdown. Now, Canada has given her asylum.

title: What Happened to the Coveted Western Tanks Sent to Ukraine?
summary: Ukraine pleaded for the expensive weapons, and ultimately got them, but drones have rendered them almost unusable.

title: Silence, Wolves and the Wild East: Hiking in Portugal’s Côa Valley
summary: A trek in a remote corner of the Iberian Peninsula brought a writer face-to-face with ancient oaks, rewilding efforts and prehistoric cave art.

title: Target Apologizes and Drops Halloween Costume Criticized as Racist
summary: Critics said the children’s costume evoked blackface imagery. Target said, “We know we got this wrong, and we are deeply sorry.”

title: Is It Time for This 95-Year-Old Pianist to Retire?
summary: Her vision and hearing are deteriorating, but she still wants to feel like she’s on top.

title: Many N.F.L. Players Get Brain Disease. Why Hasn’t OSHA Intervened?
summary: “We never see things that are this dire,” a former chief scientist of the agency said about rates of C.T.E. in former players.
